parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page.
Set PageSize to a non-empty value
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The type of statistics to query. Valid values:
exposureType: gateway assets exposed on the Internet.
exposurePort: ports exposed on the Internet.
exposureComponent: system components exposed on the Internet.
exposureIp: IP addresses exposed on the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查看的统计值类型。取值：
exposureType：暴露在互联网中的网关资产。
exposurePort：暴露在互联网中的端口。
exposureComponent：暴露在互联网中的系统组件。
exposureIp：暴露在互联网中的IP地址
parameters.name: statistics_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the gateway to query. This parameter takes effect only when StatisticsType is set to exposureType
parameters.help_zh: StatisticsType为exposureType时，指定要查询的网关实例ID
parameters.name: statistics_type_instance_value

parameters.help_en:
The Asset Type of the gateway to query. This parameter takes effect only when StatisticsType is set to exposureType. Valid values:
SLB: public IP address of a load balancing SLB instance.
DNAT: NAT gateway that uses the DNAT feature to connect to the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
StatisticsType为exposureType时，指定要查询的网关资产类型。取值：
SLB：负载均衡SLB公网IP。
DNAT：使用DNAT功能连接互联网的NAT网关
parameters.name: statistics_type_gateway_type

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource folder.
Invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the server to query
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the asset to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的资产实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The public IP address that is exposed on the Internet for the asset to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的资产对外暴露的公网IP
parameters.name: exposure_ip

Count.description_en: The number of entries on the current page in a paged query
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示的数据条数

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页最多显示的数据条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

StatisticsDetails.description_en: The list of gateway assets, exposed ports, exposed components, or public IP addresses
StatisticsDetails.description_zh: 返回的网关资产、暴露端口、暴露组件或公网IP列表

ExposedCount.description_en: The number of system vulnerability instances on your servers that are exposed on the Internet
ExposedCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的您服务器的系统漏洞数量

ExposureComponent.description_en: The system component exposed on the Internet
ExposureComponent.description_zh: 暴露在互联网中的系统组件

ExposureIp.description_en: The public IP address exposed on the Internet
ExposureIp.description_zh: 暴露在互联网中的公网IP

ExposurePort.description_en: The port exposed on the Internet
ExposurePort.description_zh: 暴露在互联网中的端口

ExposureType.description_en:
The expose type. Valid values:
INTERNET_IP: public IP addresses of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances.
SLB: public IP address of a load balancing SLB instance.
EIP: elastic IP address (EIP).
DNAT: NAT gateway that uses the DNAT feature to connect to the Internet
ExposureType.description_zh:
暴露方式。取值：
INTERNET_IP：ECS公网IP。
SLB：负载均衡SLB公网IP。
EIP：弹性公网IP。
DNAT：使用DNAT功能连接互联网的NAT网关

ExposureTypeId.description_en:
The instance ID that corresponds to the expose type. Different expose types correspond to different instance IDs. Valid values:
If ExposureType is INTERNET_IP: the value is empty.
If ExposureType is SLB: the value is the ID of the load balancing public-facing instance.
If ExposureType is EIP: the value is the ID of the EIP instance.
If ExposureType is DNAT: the value is the ID of the NAT gateway instance
ExposureTypeId.description_zh:
暴露方式对应的实例ID。不同暴露方式对应不同的实例ID，取值：
ExposureType为INTERNET_IP时：取值为空。
ExposureType为SLB时：取值为负载均衡公网实例ID。
ExposureType为EIP时：取值为弹性公网IP的实例ID。
ExposureType为DNAT时：取值为NAT网关实例ID

ExposureTypeInstanceName.description_en: The name of the gateway asset exposed on the Internet
ExposureTypeInstanceName.description_zh: 暴露在互联网中的网关资产名称

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the asset
